==English== {{wp}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|vizor||archaic}} * {{alt|en|visar|visier|visiere|visour||obsolete}} ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|viser}}, from {{der|en|xno|viser}} and {{der|en|fro|visiere}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈvaɪzɚ/|a=GA}} * {{audio|en|en-us-visor.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|aɪzə(ɹ)|s=2}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # A part of a [[helmet]], arranged so as to lift or open, and so show the face. The openings for seeing and breathing are generally in it. #: {{cot|en|bevor|buffe}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1786|author=Francis Grose|title=A Treatise on Ancient Armour and Weapons|page=7 |passage=A close helmet entirely covers the head, face, and neck, having on the front perforations for the admission of air, and slits through which the wearer may see objects around him, this part which is stiled the '''visor''' lifts up by means of a pivot over each ear.}} # A mask for the face. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1608|author=William Shakspeare|title=Pericles, Prince of Tyre|section=act IV, scene IV|line=44 |passage=No '''visor''' does become black villainy
So well as soft and tender flattery.}} # The [[forepiece|fore piece]] of a cap, projecting over, and protecting the eyes. # A rigid adjustable flap on an automobile windshield that can shield the eyes of a driver from direct sunlight or glare. ====Hyponyms==== * [[sun visor]] ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|visorless|visorlike}} ====Related terms==== * {{l|en|vizard}}, {{l|en|visard}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|part of a helmet}} * Bulgarian: * Czech: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Finnish: * French: * Georgian: * German: * Hungarian: * Latin: * Macedonian: * Norwegian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|забра́ло|n}} * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-see|mask}} {{trans-top|fore piece of a cap}} * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Czech: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Finnish: * French: * Georgian: * German: * Hebrew: * Hungarian: * Māori: * Norwegian: * Polish: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|козырёк|m}} * Spanish: * Swedish: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Vietnamese: {{trans-bottom}} {{checktrans-top}} * Hebrew: {{t-check|he|החלק בקסדה שנפתח להראות את הפנים}}, {{t-check|he|מסכה פשוטה}}, {{t-check|he|מצחייה, בכובע}} {{trans-bottom}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To cover with, or as if with, a visor. #: {{ant|en|unvisor}} {{C|en|Headwear|Armor}}
